name: Segurança
processes: ISO/IEC 27001 information security risk assessment and treatment
Microsoft SDL threat modeling and security response
measure: The security posture: risks assessed but untreated, architecture elements without a threat model or with a suspect one, vulnerabilities past their deadline, applicable controls with a gap or only partial, high advisories affecting (Fornecimento) and credentials past rotation.
description: Security risks with their treatment, threat models of the architecture, vulnerabilities of the repository's own code and the controls of a reference catalog with their applicability (D-321).
